repos_data.description: PraisonAI is a production-ready Multi AI Agents framework, designed to create AI Agents to automate and solve problems ranging from simple tasks to complex challenges. It provides a low-code solution to streamline the building and management of multi-agent LLM systems, emphasising simplicity, customisation, and effective human-agent collaboration.
Build agentic systems. Run them with confidence. Orchestrate agents, automate business processes, inspect every execution, and keep humans in control. Deploy Heym on your own infrastructure.
